Archival Dispatch: 15 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Dr. Tim Detective, Erik Bauersfeld's Black Mass, Two Daffodils, and Uncle Ezra

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 4 min
Tags: Dr Tim Detective, The Black Mass, Erik Bauersfeld, Lord Dunsany, Ambrose Bierce, KPFA, Two Daffodils, Ken Gillum, Duke Atterbury, Uncle Ezra, Pat Barrett, Station EZRA, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 70 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 70 recovers and dates 15 historical radio broadcasts spanning 1940s medical detective procedurals, Erik Bauersfeld's acclaimed Pacifica Radio Gothic horror adaptations, 1930s Hollywood vaudeville musical comedy, and rural broadcast humor from the National Barn Dance: 4 solved cases from Dr. Tim, Detective (1948, featuring clinical mysteries, canine clues, and forensic poison investigations), 3 spine-chilling literary horror productions from Erik Bauersfeld's The Black Mass (KPFA Berkeley, 1964–1965, adapting Lord Dunsany and Ambrose Bierce), 4 rare Hollywood musical comedy transcriptions from The Two Daffodils (Ken Gillum and Duke Atterbury on Continental Broadcasting, 1934), and 4 episodes of Pat Barrett's beloved small-town comedy Uncle Ezra (1935–1936, broadcasting from the fictional 5-watt station E-Z-R-A in Rosedale).
